bodyHtml:
What This Is

Technology-driven platform delivering multi-family office investment capabilities (alternatives, tax, estate, philanthropy) to the $1-10M segment at a fraction of traditional cost..

Pilot deployments and early-stage commercial testing underway. Technology is proven at small scale. Our research database tracks 1 independent source on this technology.

Digital MFO model extends capabilities to $1-10M segment via technology-driven portfolio construction, alternatives access, tax tools and reporting. AI delivers MFO experience at fraction of traditional cost. BCG 2026.
